subject: Quick question on deadline after priority shift
text:
Hi,

Sorry, this is a little scattered, but I got confused about the deadlines after the priority change. Is the report now due before the stakeholder call, or after the team shares comments? I also saw the budget section moved forward, and I am not sure if that means the draft is tomorrow afternoon or just the numbers. If the client meeting is still Thursday, do I need the visuals by Wednesday morning? I have two notes open and one says original plan, so I may be mixing them. Please clarify only the next real date I should hit. I also need to know whether the slide deck is part of the same submission, because I thought that section was optional. Sorry again.
